svg.title: TribeSolutions / fiscal platform
svg.desc: Local implementation · no Sefaz transmission yet Browser → Laravel portal: PHP / Blade · session, CSRF and organization role, Review registrations, fiscal profiles and draft versions. Application services + PostgreSQL: Snapshots, exact decimals and number allocation, Version conflicts, locks, attempts and audit records, A1 vault: AES-256-GCM; key outside the database. XML, documents and controlled transport: NFePHP: XML, offline signature and DANFE preview, Draft PDF without numbering or fiscal authorization, SOAP / HTTPS code; default transport disabled. Planned: external Sefaz flow: Issuer readiness and authorized homologation test, Submit, consult and reconcile uncertain outcomes
